verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents an official MCP server (confirmed by a probe of its docs page) that lets MCP-compatible agents such as Claude, Cursor, Antigravity and Claude Code search docs, manage indexes, upsert data and query indexes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI agents to Pinecone through the MCP server to search docs, manage indexes, and query data from Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, or Claude Code.
Using the MCP server, agents can search Pinecone documentation, manage indexes, upsert data, and query indexes for relevant information.
